item.title: Jury trial postponed for former Wasatch County Sheriff’s Office employee facing felony sex charges
item.description: The four-day jury trial for former Wasatch County Sheriff’s Office employee Mitchell McKee has been postponed. McKee, who is facing 10 felony charges, will now face a trial by jury the week of Oct. 19. The post Jury trial postponed for former Wasatch County Sheriff’s Office employee facing felony sex charges appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: Shannon Wilson is preserving the artistry of ice skating at Midway’s open-air rink
item.description: Shannon Wilson, manager of Midway’s ice rink, loves her job. She sharpens rental skates, smooths out the ice with a Zamboni and helps keep the open-air rink maintained. But Wilson’s love of skating did not originate with Midway’s rink — it was fueled by her years as a professional skater who competed in venues worldwide. The post Shannon Wilson is preserving the artistry of ice skating at Midway’s open-air rink appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: How Mark Avery uses ancient currency to unlock the past
item.description: Mark Avery began collecting coins when he was about 10 years old. As a reward for yard work, Avery’s father would bring back rolls of dimes from the bank.
